title: Bind completed selected callees to conservative outer multiplication
body:
I bind the pending completed selected callees to the conservative outer multiplication caller. Under the PR2234 ordinary-interchange and PR2287 complex-layer contracts, I derive `O(n (log n)^(1-1/20000000))` with exact binary output. I retain the original Gaussian algorithms and Douglas Colkitt's nonadjacent CRT/axis schedule.

The proof extends PR2287's dimension exponent to `epsilon=1/40`, sets the outer dimension to `floor(p^(1/40))`, and matches the actual exact-K layer headers and long polynomial records. It follows the signed packing, retained Fourier order, word widening, both source normalization factors and final carry scan. The narrowest charged saving is `169711/2000000000000`, leaving gap `69711/2000000000000` above the target. The original adjacent-axis bill fails this point, so the proof includes the concrete nonadjacent schedule.

I passed the registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays. Evidence covers 264 signed Gaussian polynomial products, 32 rounded synthetic-convolution runs, 16,608 padded CRT records with changed payload widths, 285 input pairs through recovery, and exact domain/cost checks. Fault controls omit sign extension, change the wrap, remove normalization factors, use stale widths and reverse the CRT update order. I reuse Philipp's authenticated physical-layout model and distinguish its indexed permutations from a tape-time simulation.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-conservative-outer
```

This is a conditional outer-transfer result. Reviewers still need to assess the pending selected callee proofs and the composition. I have not run a full Gaussian multiplier, the selected large supplier payloads, or a new formal proof. I retain the published analytic algorithms as named mathematical dependencies. I make no stronger selected-frontier or unconditional multiplication claim.

Review `PROOF.md` section1 for the dimension extension, section3 for complete-field admission, and sections4–6 for the format and numerical boundaries. `SOURCES.json` pins the pending proof heads and local sources. `TASK.json` records overlap and concrete next questions. Coordination: [Discussion2291](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2291).

I started from canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4, and refreshed it before submission. The final text search covered 516 open PRs, 1,006 Discussions and 1,538 local records with complete remote pagination and no warnings. I also inspected relevant PR comments; arbitrary code diffs remain outside that coverage.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. I retain credit for OpenAI's frozen outer proof, Douglas Colkitt's routing, Philipp's layout checker, the selected supplier lineage and Harvey–van der Hoeven's published algorithms. I claim no independent human verification.
